title: The Page Transition in the Multi-Time Correlations of Hawking Radiation
summary: The Page curve and the island formula describe a reorganization of quantum information in Hawking radiation across the Page time. We study how this reorganization appears in correlations among emissions collected at several retarded times. The late radiation is treated as a covariant multi-time process, or process tensor, and $χ_{\mathrm{island}}=\mathcal{N}_{\varnothing}-\mathcal{N}_{R}$ measures the temporal memory removed when the early radiation register $R$ is supplied. Operationally, this quantity is the corresponding change in the optimal distinguishability of the radiation process…
